how: The starter reports beginning the mark and being joined by other members before later crediting their completed work.
Repeated calls recruit members to start, enlarge, outline and finish the shared mark.
A one-line assent directly answers a proposed design without asking for anything back.
Members negotiate background colours, outlines, lettering, band figures and a later redesign.
Builders report progress and offer placements on specific parts of the shared work.
Anchor coordinates, a gridded design and measured colour sections translate proposals into placeable instructions.
A reported Discord decision returns as a Reddit colour plan, invitation and directive to stop undoing intended changes.
After deciding in chat, organizers explain intended changes to contributors whose repairs still follow an earlier design.
Visible disorganization supports improvised coordination but cannot establish the absence of decided order within unavailable chat discussions.
Preservation and chat directives give no evidence deciding whether placement scripts or spare accounts were used.
An additional image meets an explicit claim of insufficient space and proposals to repurpose existing lettering.
Members call for defence against encroachment and later recount preserving their corners.
An eraser acknowledges mistaking a friendly outline for damage and offers to help after the builder gives up.
Defence requires distinguishing intended changes from damage because mistaken protection can obstruct building and trigger withdrawal.
Recognizing the current chat-decided plan distinguishes intended recolouring from apparent vandalism and allows repair efforts to be redirected.
Neighbours propose compromise boundaries, announce a truce, report repeated breaches and demand compliance.
Members restrain encroachment, apologize for damage and help repair the neighbour's work.
A self-described representative approaches the room and other participants return an agreement negotiated through chat.
Participants ask another room for help while border exchanges also yield repair help and reciprocal promises of care.
Reciprocal promises of looking out for one another support a minimal bilateral alliance rather than a documented larger coalition.
A neighbour requests permission to retain overlapping hair pixels and receives conditional tolerance limited against further expansion.
Qualified personal assent and uneven compliance show limited representation without establishing a dispute over an appointed leader's authority.
Space constraints on an additional picture and survival of the original mark do not establish loss followed by relocation.
Individual proposals endorse taking disputed space or covering the smaller neighbour without demonstrating coordinated execution.
A post-close reply carries the neighbour's destruction into the continuing dispute without identifying who caused it.
An internal music controversy is recalled but no concept establishes a pre-canvas quarrel with the neighbouring target.
The explicit covering proposal invokes the target's small following rather than documenting an inherited rivalry as the reason for attack.
Members celebrate survival, thank helpers, claim individual pixels and reflect on shared accomplishment.
Collective pride must allow uneven enthusiasm because wanting the event to end coexists with celebration and acknowledged local frustration.
Completion posting includes checking for duplicate celebration and offering deletion rather than treating every repeated post as independent enthusiasm.
Participants recount the logo's preservation, neighbouring losses and their own defence after placement has ended.
A canvas neighbour's request recruits ordinary music recommendations into continued contact without demonstrating a durable inter-room institution.
Canvas proximity brings a visitor who asks about the room, receives explanations and explicitly values the connection.
The visitor explicitly grounds a request for ordinary cultural guidance in the prior neighbour relationship rather than in a saved canvas record.
Post-close praise and recollections do not document contest over a cleaned shared canvas or over which historical version should be retained.
The explicit April Fools reveal and replies extend the room's own song-of-the-week reversal separately from canvas instructions.
An unofficial organizer gathers inconsistent plans into one thread without asserting moderator authority.
Anticipating relief at the event's end does not by itself establish objection to a posting flood or a request to contain canvas talk.
Band attachment and identification as the existing fan community motivate participation in the shared mark.
Teasing a neighbour's current wording is visible but does not establish that the phrase was an inherited in-joke.
A joke-post title without its linked media cannot establish the specific joke or its continuity with earlier fandom lore.

statement: contesting and repairing a joke within completion talk
how: A false death joke draws emotional rejection and reassurance, preserving interpersonal disagreement within an otherwise celebratory exchange.
The starter's report explicitly links the initial effort with several users subsequently working alongside them.
The member directing others to their own work also asks them to help extend it.
Defence begins while the design is still developing, so keeping the work cannot be treated as a distinct stage after total completion.
A compromise is offered inside a defence exchange that explicitly identifies the neighbour as attacking the mark.
A treaty can guide restraint only among placers who hear and accept it, while repair and deliberate encroachment can coexist.
Defence is visible but neither the unseen chat nor the survival reports establish whether upkeep escalated into machine placement.
The starter explicitly connects the completed logo with pride in everyone who participated.
Announcement, retrospective reporting and praise occur together, so their coexistence does not establish that celebration caused a separate later recording stage.
Continued neighbour contact is explicitly grounded in shared proximity rather than shown to arise from preserving a record of the work.
Insufficient room for additional art does not imply that the established mark was lost or that the room relocated.
A posted grid supplies guidance while later replies continue changing the design, so template circulation cannot be taken as settlement.
A posted design proposal directly receives bare assent, without establishing any response by silent readers.
Pressure prompts an outside plea, but a request and its reported delivery do not establish that outside helpers answered or placed pixels.
Repair and reciprocal promises follow border trouble without documenting a barter of specified space for upkeep.
Recruitment and attack proposals coexist without a passage demonstrating that a particular recruitment call caused the attack proposal.
A reply explicitly tells readers to ignore the instigator of a blackout call.
An announced construction to the right directly receives a request to stop that explicitly invokes the border treaty.
A later report of the neighbour's destruction neither identifies its attackers nor establishes that the earlier construction proposal caused the outcome.
Mutual-care promises arise during border repair without establishing that a shared outside threat caused the bilateral tie.
The organizing thread explicitly responds to inconsistent plans rather than demonstrating that a posting flood caused containment.
Limited authority is stated inside acceptance of the compromise rather than shown to emerge later as a separate rebellion against it.
